paragraphs: Begin the day answering messages and negotiating contracts, then arrange schedules to prevent conflicts. Meet brands in the afternoon to discuss partnerships, respond immediately when a public-relations issue appears, and calculate revenue shares at month-end. The work also involves supporting clients emotionally and competing for opportunities.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 21,400 agents and business managers employed in 2024, rising to a projected 23,200 by 2034. That is a net gain of roughly 1,800 jobs and about 2,200 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $96,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).

AI will not replace agents, but it will assist with contract drafting and data-driven casting. Models can screen business matches and draft terms, shifting agents from finding opportunities toward negotiating major deals and protecting clients. Pure intermediaries face pressure, while skilled negotiators with strong networks become more valuable.
